'''NisdiGen''' was a company specialized in media equipments during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It produced items such as the [[Suite 60]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
NisdiGen was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
